h1: WordPress site build, ready for launch
overview: We build your WordPress site from nothing, or on hosting you already pay for. We install WordPress and a fast, editor-friendly theme, set your logo, colors and fonts, then create the pages you need with working contact forms. We add the basics for search, security and backups and check the site on phones. You get a private preview, a launch checklist and a short guide to editing your own pages.

faq: Can you build the site if I have no hosting yet?
Yes. We recommend hosts that suit your needs, you create the account and pay the host directly, then add us as a user. We set everything up inside your own hosting.
Do you write the page text?
You send the text and images you have. If you need help, we tidy your wording and can write short page copy when you add the optional copy add-on.
Can I edit the site myself later?
Yes. We choose editor-friendly tools and show you how to change text, images and menus. Nothing is locked, and you own the site and its logins.
Do I pay for themes and plugins?
Free tools are used wherever they do the job. If a paid theme or plugin is worth it, we tell you the price first, and you buy the licence in your own name.
